description: Source code for a Zephyr logging backend implementation for ADSP MTrace, managing debug log buffers, hooks, and concurrency control.

methods.name: mtrace_init
methods.description: Initializes the debug slot for MTrace logging.

methods.name: mtrace_out
methods.description: Outputs log data into the debug buffer, managing buffer pointers.

methods.name: char_out
methods.description: Handles character output, invoking hook if active.

methods.name: format_flags
methods.description: Returns current format flags based on configuration.

methods.name: panic
methods.description: Sets panic mode for the logging backend.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes log messages, applying formatting and concurrency control.

methods.name: adsp_mtrace_log_init
methods.description: Public function to initialize MTrace logging with a hook.

methods.name: log_backend_adsp_mtrace_get
methods.description: Returns the log backend structure for external use.
